tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

Certificate verification is enabled in every build, development builds included; this replaces the earlier practice of disabling it in development. Nothing is exempt from HTTPS either: the project uses HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exceptions, and certificate management is already in place. When testing, use self-signed certificates rather than turning verification off.
EOF
